doc.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

title: Originality and Jimmy Zito
summary: Jimmy Zito's remark on jazz never being heard twice; Ross identifies Zito from Les Brown and the Tonight Show band.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: A lot of folks have been talking about originality and that should be something that you strive for.

Oh, yes. That’s the fun of it if you can. One friend of mine, Jimmy Zito, says the fun of jazz is that what you play at that particular time was never be heard before or be heard since. Some of it’s been heard before in my case.
I want to tell them that Jimmy Zito was one of our trumpet players in the California Tonight Show band. He was very well known before that, he was with Les Brown for many years. Great guy.
